messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Dedicated pool node alarm
incident-bot: pool=sapphire-dedpool node=gpu-07 region=us-west-2 alert=PCIe_AER+ECC_spike tenants=[southbloom] impact=api_errors rate=~6/min
erin-oncall: Acked. Oncall here, pulling it in. @maria-sre can you take primary? I’ll handle customer comms.
maria-sre: taking. starting triage - pulling logs and current placements. Can someone cordon the node?
leo-ops: cordoning now: `redwoodctl node cordon gpu-07 --pool sapphire-dedpool`
leo-ops: cordon OK. No new allocations to gpu-07.
maria-sre: beginning drain for active tenants with graceful 30s timeout:
```
redwoodctl node drain --pool sapphire-dedpool --node gpu-07 --timeout 30s --force=false
```
maria-sre: drain output: migrating 1 active session for tenant southbloom -> routing to pool=sapphire-dedpool:gpu-12, migration success 1/1
sam-hw: HW oncall standing by. ECC counters show increases on gpu-07, nvlink errors transient. We'll prepare hot-swap but need tenant migrated first. ETA tech swap ~45m if node needs RMA.
jess-cs: pinged SouthBloom SE team, said they see sporadic inference errors and increased latencies, not complete outages. They're fine with planned migration if we keep them updated.
erin-oncall: Noted customer impact: errors ~10% of requests for SouthBloom's vpc endpoints, mostly long-tail. Escalating to account manager and logging incident in pager duty.
deploy-bot: Canary routing rule applied: southbloom -> fallback_pool=reserved-evict-fallback for new requests.
maria-sre: Confirmed evacuated all active sessions from gpu-07. Marking node quarantined and disabling health checks to prevent flapping: `redwoodctl node quarantine gpu-07`
leo-ops: Quarantine command applied. Node removed from LB.
sam-hw: Doing quick hardware checks: pulled ECC logs, flashed BMC microcode v1.2.7 to clear AER state. If errors persist we will replace card.
maria-sre: Post-migration validation: southbloom endpoints showing 200 OKs and latency back to baseline. Monitoring for 15m.
jess-cs: Updating customer: "We routed traffic away from the affected host and are seeing normal behavior again. We'll follow up with a hardware summary."
erin-oncall: Good. Scheduling a short postmortem next week. Action items: 1) Replace GPU on gpu-07 if ECC rate doesn't stay low, 2) add automated preemptive routing for sustained AER spikes, 3) update runbook to include BMC microcode step.
maria-sre: Adding runbook note and incident timeline to incidents board. Closing thread when postmortem scheduled. :white_check_mark:
